metadata_bind_host.description: The IP address the metadata agent binds to. Use '0.0.0.0' to bind to all interfaces.

metadata_bind_port.description: TCP port the metadata agent listens on.

neutron_config_file.description: Path to the main Neutron configuration file.

nova_metadata_ini.description: Path to the Nova configuration file (for metadata proxy authorization).

metadata_proxy_shared_secret.description: Shared secret used to sign metadata request headers. Must match the value in nova.conf.

workers.description: Number of worker processes for the metadata agent.

rpc_workers.description: Number of RPC worker processes for handling notifications.

log_dir.description: Directory for log files (used if log_file is not set).

log_date_format.description: Date/time format used in log messages.

debug_loggers.description: List of logger names to enable debug logging for.

metadata_workers.description: Number of workers for metadata request handling (legacy alias for workers).

metadata_service_ssl.description: Use SSL/TLS for communication with the metadata service endpoint.

metadata_service_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate file for metadata service SSL.

metadata_service_cert.description: Path to client certificate file for metadata service SSL.

metadata_service_key.description: Path to client private key file for metadata service SSL.

metadata_proxy_healthcheck_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metadata proxy health checks.

metadata_proxy_healthcheck_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for metadata proxy health checks.

metadata_proxy_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for metadata proxy requests.

metadata_proxy_retry_delay.description: Delay (seconds) between retries for metadata proxy requests.

use_ssl_with_nova.description: Use SSL/TLS when connecting to the Nova metadata service.

nova_metadata_insecure.description: Allow insecure connections to Nova metadata service (disable certificate verification).

nova_metadata_client_cert.description: Path to client certificate for Nova metadata SSL.

nova_metadata_client_key.description: Path to client private key for Nova metadata SSL.

nova_metadata_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for Nova metadata SSL.

agent_report_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between agent status reports to the Neutron server.
